name: Video Station
description: Browse and watch the videos on your NAS: a cinema library with poster shelves, Continue Watching, Movies/Series, search and My List; HLS playback for HEVC/AC3/MKV on desktop and phones; resume, subtitles, keyless metadata (Cinemeta/TVmaze) with optional TMDB, and a media-engine panel (VA-API/QuickSync/software). The video API stays in EthOS so the Android Video app keeps working.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 2.1.3: shared folders and their videos now appear directly on the Home tab in “Shared folders” and “Shared with you” shelves — no need to open the Shared tab first; shared titles are marked read-only and cannot be added to My List (requires EthOS 2.13.3). 2.1.2: playback fixes — asks the server for the audio codec this browser can decode (AAC, Opus, or video-only with a notice) and always uses hls.js when Media Source is available, so Safari/Android Chrome no longer fail on the bounded live window. The player logs the real error, retries once, shows the reason with a "Try again" button, and frees a session that arrives after the window closed. movies that showed a black screen and "The stream could not be played" play again — AAC muxed from E-AC-3 "5.1(side)" tracks (the usual layout in WEB-DL rips) is now normalised to a standard 5.1 layout, which Chrome accepts. The player also logs the real error, retries the stream once and shows the reason with a "Try again" button. 2.1.0: metadata works without an API key — Cinemeta (movies and series, posters/backdrops/rating/cast) plus TVmaze (official series fallback), with an optional TMDB key for Polish titles and overviews. New provider picker, per-source health check, missing/re-fetch-all actions, source attribution and automatic bounded metadata fetch. Requires EthOS 2.13.0. 2.0.0: new cinema UI (full-bleed top nav, backdrop hero, poster shelves, detail pages, bottom tab bar on phones), server-side HLS playback for HEVC/AC3/MKV with VA-API/QuickSync hardware decode and encode, a real media-engine panel with probe diagnostics, working quality/audio/subtitle pickers, server-side My List, responsive touch layout and lazy poster loading. Requires EthOS 2.12.0. 1.0.2: renamed to Videos as part of the EthOS 2.0 product naming (ids and APIs unchanged). 1.0.1: light theme for the shell, rows and empty states (the hero and player stay cinematic), and adding a folder uses the EthOS folder picker. 1.0.0: first release.
